issues.description: Bitmap24 storage method is named inconsistently across artifacts. In the template repository header (example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp) the member is declared as 'void write(const std::string &i_filename);' while the template implementation (example_program/src/Bitmap24.cpp) defines 'void Bitmap24::save(const std::string &i_filename)' and the template main (example_program/src/main.cpp) calls 'bitmap.save(outfile);'. The solution repository consistently uses 'save(...)' (declaration and implementation). This mismatch between the header declaration ('write') and the implementation/usage ('save') prevents successful compilation of the template and will confuse students about the intended API.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the API name in the template to match the implementation and solution. Preferred fix: change the declaration in example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp from 'void write(const std::string &i_filename);' to 'void save(const std::string &i_filename);' so header, implementation (Bitmap24::save) and call sites (bitmap.save(...)) are consistent. Alternatively, rename the implementation and all call sites to 'write'. Update any tests or documentation accordingly.
